name: set_leverage
description: Set leverage for a trading position. Higher leverage amplifies both profits and losses. Use with caution as it increases risk significantly.

category.description: Product category to set leverage for

symbol.description: Trading pair symbol to set leverage for

buyLeverage.description: Leverage for long positions. Range depends on symbol (e.g., 1-100x)

sellLeverage.description: Leverage for short positions. Range depends on symbol (e.g., 1-100x)

name: switch_cross_isolated_margin
description: Switch between cross margin (uses entire account balance as collateral) and isolated margin (uses only position margin). Cross margin has lower liquidation risk but affects entire account.

category.description: Product category to change margin mode for

symbol.description: Trading pair symbol to change margin mode for

tradeMode.description: Margin mode: 0 = cross margin (shared account balance), 1 = isolated margin (separate position margin)

buyLeverage.description: Leverage for long positions after mode switch

sellLeverage.description: Leverage for short positions after mode switch

name: switch_position_mode
description: Switch between one-way mode (net position) and hedge mode (separate long/short positions). Hedge mode allows simultaneous long and short positions on the same symbol.

category.description: Product category to change position mode for

symbol.description: Trading pair symbol (optional for some categories, required for linear/inverse)

mode.description: Position mode: 0 = One-Way Mode (net position), 3 = Hedge Mode (separate buy/sell positions)

name: set_trading_stop
description: Set take profit and stop loss orders for an existing position. These orders automatically close your position at specified profit or loss levels to manage risk.

symbol.description: Trading pair symbol for the position

positionIdx.description: Position index: 0 = one-way mode, 1 = hedge-mode Buy side, 2 = hedge-mode Sell side

takeProfit.description: Take profit price to automatically close position at profit target

stopLoss.description: Stop loss price to automatically close position to limit losses

tpslMode.description: TP/SL mode for partial position closure

tpOrderType.description: Take profit order type when triggered

slOrderType.description: Stop loss order type when triggered

tpSize.description: Take profit size for partial closure

slSize.description: Stop loss size for partial closure

name: set_auto_add_margin
description: Enable or disable automatic margin addition for isolated margin positions. When enabled, margin is automatically added to prevent liquidation.

symbol.description: Trading pair symbol for the position

autoAddMargin.description: Auto add margin setting: 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled

positionIdx.description: Position index: 0 = one-way mode, 1 = hedge-mode Buy side, 2 = hedge-mode Sell side

name: modify_position_margin
description: Manually add or reduce margin for an isolated margin position. Use positive values to add margin (reduce liquidation risk) or negative values to reduce margin.

symbol.description: Trading pair symbol for the position

margin.description: Margin amount to add (positive) or reduce (negative). In quote currency for linear, base currency for inverse

positionIdx.description: Position index: 0 = one-way mode, 1 = hedge-mode Buy side, 2 = hedge-mode Sell side
